Around [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], '''political activists''' on [[Galidraan/Legends|Galidraan]] were branded as rebels by the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Governor of Galidraan|governor]]. The [[Governor/Legends|governor]] hired [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] mercenaries under [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] to destroy the rebels, but was in truth simply operating under the directive of [[Tor Vizsla]] and his anti-Mandalorian [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]]. Fett and his mercenaries killed all of the activists just prior to the [[Battle of Galidraan]].
